title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Nidaamka wareeggoyska aqoonta
bridge: Faransiis, si aad u rabto inaad nidaam furto, waxaad ku isticmaashaa mudarka waagii isku halleeyey ilaa jeer lagu soo jeedo arrimaha raay. Ingiriisi, mudarka isku halleeyey waa yar yaree; waxaa u jeclaa mudarka xilliga ama xukummadka modal. Misaal, 'ma u maleynayaa inay tahay saxah' waxaa laguma qoro 'I don't think it is right' (maahee 'it be right'). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, isticmaalka 'should' iyo 'would' oo ku saabsan xukummad iyo xaalad aan la egayn faransiiska, meesha aan u isticmaalo mudarka xilli each. Fiirso xaaladda adverbi iyo aanu iska leh diinle double negation Ingiriisi.
rule: Si aad rabto inaad nidaam furto Ingiriisi degmada B2, isticmaalo: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + xukunka xilliga: 'I think that...' (maahee isku halleeyey). 2) Modal: 'should' (tashriic), 'ought to' (rasmi), 'must' (waajib mabad), 'can't' (aan la qadro), 'could' (la qadro), 'would' (go'an). 3) Xukummadka agreement/disagreement: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Xaaladaha aqoonta: 'If we allowed... , then...' (xili ka kooban), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (xili labaad). 5) Xiriirka: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Ka saar diinle double negation ('I don't agree with nothing' waa khalad) iyo isticmaala furarka si aad u xisaabiso: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in tijaabada hayaweynta ah ay yihiin aan la aqoon la'aan iyadoo la qalmo jira adagga aan la qadro.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan ku noqday xaaladkaan, waxaan ku dhahi lahaa runta, haddii ay tahay adag.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Qaar ka mid ah dadku waxay u yidhaahdaan in mirayntii la midiyey jiniyaha ah ay tahay la qadro inay ku fadiistaan dunida, laakiin qaar kalana ma ay isku leh.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayaan inoo oggolaan inaanan ku fidno qaynka qalabka; labaduba waa u muhiim.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadku wuxuu muujdaa maxaa yeelay faransiiska waxaa amaanaa diinle double negation ('No creo que no sea ético'), laakiin Ingiriisi jweel waa in la qoro diinle negation oo kaluhay. Si aad u qaado khaladka, ka saar 'not' kaluhay ama u beddel ilaa erayada la soo jeeda (unethical).

examples.original: In my opinion, we should recycle more.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, wiː ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl mɔːr/
examples.translation: Raayada ii, waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u badbaadinno dhawr badan.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'in my opinion' ugu horreysa si aad u xisaabiso fiirkaaga.

examples.original: I strongly believe that every child deserves a quality education.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈɛvri tʃaɪld dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈkwɒləti ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa qalbi in oo dhan ilmo ay u hayaan farsamo saxah.
examples.note: Adverb 'strongly' wuxuu u yimaa ugu horreysa fiilka 'believe'.

examples.original: From my perspective, this policy has more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspɛktɪv, ðɪs ˈpɒləsi hæz mɔːr ˈbɛnɪfɪts ðæn ˈdrɔːbæks/
examples.translation: Fiirka ii, siyaasadkan waxay leedahay faa'iido badan kulankaan u yar.
examples.note: Ka saar tarjumaadka adag 'Bajo mi punto de vista'.

examples.original: I couldn't agree more with your argument about renewable energy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkʊdnt əˈɡriː mɔːr wɪð jɔːr ˈɑːrɡjumənt əˈbaʊt rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Ma aan qadro inaan isku halleeyo calaamadii ku saabsan energy-ga diideed.
examples.note: Tusaalehan wuxuu u yahay isku halligood qaran. Ha isku leh 'I can't agree' (ma aan isku leh).

examples.original: I see your point, but I think there are other factors to consider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jɔːr pɔɪnt, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðeər ɑːr ˈʌðər ˈfæktərz tuː kənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: Waxaan ogahay fiirkaaga, laakiin waxaan u maleynayaa inay jiraan xaalad kale oo la qaadi lahaa.
examples.note: Tusaalehan wuxuu u yahay isku xiga si aan u xumaan.

examples.original: That may be true, however, we must also think about the long-term effects.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ biː truː, haʊˈɛvər, wiː mʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɔːŋtɜːrm ɪˈfɛkts/
examples.translation: Waxay noqon kartaa run, laakiin, waxaan u maleynayaa inaanan u maleynayo xaaladaha ay u dhexeen waqtiga dheer.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'however' ilaa jeer lagu soo jeedo xaalad.

examples.original: If the government banned all private cars, the air quality would improve significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt bænd ɔːl ˈpraɪvɪt kɑːrz, ðiː ɛər ˈkwɒləti wʊd ɪmˈpruːv sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Haddii dadweynaha ay noqoto inay noqoto dhaw iyo dhaw, xaaladda hawada waxay u badan doontaa si aan la qadro.
examples.note: Xili labaad oo ku saabsan xaalad aan la egayn ama aan la egayn. Ingiriisi, isticmaala 'were' kala duwan 'was' oo dhan ee ku saabsan xili.

examples.original: If I were the CEO, I would prioritize employee well-being over profits.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˌsiː.iːˈoʊ, aɪ wʊd praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈprɒfɪts/
examples.translation: Haddii aan ahay madaxtooyinka, waxaan u jeedin lahaa wanaagga shaqaalaha ka badan maqaalkii.
examples.note: Isticmaalka saxah 'were' ee ku saabsan mudarka isku halleeyey. Badasha faransiiska waxay ku dhahantaa 'I was'.

examples.original: What would you do if you found a wallet with a thousand dollars inside?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː faʊnd ə ˈwɔːlɪt wɪð ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɒlərz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
examples.translation: Maxaad samayn doontaa haddii aad helaysaa sac u dhexdeeda miiyaanyal oo boqol oo dollar?
examples.note: Xukunka su'aala xili: fariin 'would' ugu horreysa.

examples.original: If we don't act now, future generations will suffer the consequences.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃənz wɪl ˈsʌfər ðə ˈkɒnsɪkwɛnsɪz/
examples.translation: Haddii aanan samaynin imminka, jiyadii ay noqon doonaan ayay ku dhexaysaa xumaanta.
examples.note: Xili kooban oo ku saabsan xaalad run iyo la egayn.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Luqada Istaraajiyada Wadaagga
bridge: Faransiis, waxaan ku tiro sanaag sanayn inaan isticmaalno luqada subjunctive inaan u eg noqo mid adag ('quisiera', 'me gustaría'), waxaase in English ku isticmaalno modal verbs sida 'would', 'could' iyo 'might' si ay u heshiin xaalad la mid ah, laakiin qalab kale. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ku dhawaad qofka af-Soomaaliga wuxuu u adag yahay inuu u jawaabo furashada, waxaase in English ku sugan in 'no' la qalbi jirro luqadaha 'I'm afraid' ama 'unfortunately'. Iska yaraa inaad 'de acuerdo' u tarjimi furan 'I am agree' - fiilka saxda ah waa 'agree' oo aan la isticmaalno auxiliary verb.
rule: Wadaagga English deggan B2, waxaa la isticmaalno modal verbs in lagu soo bixiyo adag iyo xaalado (would, could, might, may). Qalabka 'I would suggest...' ama 'We could consider...' waxay u fiican yihiin 'I want...' ama 'You must...'. In lagu soo bixiyo go'aan kale, waxaa la isticmaalno 'What if...' ama 'How about...' oo la raacdo gerund ama xukun. In lagu soo bixiyo la xiriir adag, waxaa la isticmaalno luqadaha 'I see your point, but...' ama 'I'm afraid that...'. Wadaagga shuruudaha, waxaa la isticmaalno conditional sentences (If... then...). Xusuuso in English, 'agree' waa fiil, ma aha mid aad u adag, sidaas daraaddeed 'I am agree' ma ay noqon karo, laakiin 'I agree'.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan soo bandhigay inaan u odhaanno muddiga dhammaadka ilaa toddobaadka ee rayid.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount if you increase the order volume.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u fikiri karnaa khasmaynta haddii aad ku daranto tirada talada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid that price is a bit higher than we expected.
concept_examples.translation: Waan ka baqayaa in qiimahaas ay yihiin badnaan si aan u sugno wixii aannu u fiirnaynay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

concept_examples.text: What if we split the difference and meet in the middle?
concept_examples.translation: Maxaad u maleynaysaan inaan u soo baxanno xiliga dhexdhexaad ee ku soo baxay?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadka waxay noqotay maxaa yeelay af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugu yidhaahdo 'aan u adag yahay' (isticmaalka fiilka 'estar' + nool), oo ay la soo jeedin furan 'I am agree'. English, 'agree' waa fiil kaamil, ma aha mid aad u adag, sidaas daraaddeed 'to be' ma ay isticmaalno. Inaad ka saartid khalaadkan, xusuuso in 'agree' waxay u eg tahay 'u adag' ama 'u adag' laakiin aan la isticmaalno auxiliary verb 'be'. Waxaa la isticmaalno adverbi 'completely' ama 'partially' in lagu qalbi jiro.

examples.original: I would like to propose a different approach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə prəˈpoʊz ə ˈdɪfərənt əˈproʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaan inaan soo bandhigoo diyaarsan kale.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'would like to' si aad u eg noqo mid adag iyo mid adag, waxay u eg tahay 'quisiera' af-Soomaaliga laakiin aan la isticmaalno subjunctive.

examples.original: How about meeting next Tuesday?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈmitɪŋ nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
examples.translation: Maxaad u maleynaysaan inaan kulmano malaxashii ee dambe?
examples.note: 'How about' oo la raacdo gerund waa qalab culus oo lagu soo bixiyo soobix. Ma ay tarjimi furan karo.

examples.original: I suggest we revisit the terms of the contract.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst wi riˈvɪzɪt ðə tɜrmz əv ðə ˈkɑntrækt/
examples.translation: Waxaan soo bandhigay inaan cusboonaysiinayso shuruudaha xisaabinta.
examples.note: English, 'suggest' oo ka dib wuxuu soo baxay subjunctive base (aan la isticmaalno 's' saddexad), waxay u eg tahay subjunctive af-Soomaaliga.

examples.original: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the timeline.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt aɪ hæv sʌm kənˈsɜrnz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
examples.translation: Waxaan ogahay nuqulkaaga, laakiin waxaan qabanayaa baawaho ku saabsan waqtiga.
examples.note: Qalabkan wuxuu u qalbi jirraa la xiriir adag oo ugu horreeya nuqulka qofka kale.

examples.original: I'm afraid that's not quite what we had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæts nɑt kwaɪt wʌt wi hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Waan ka baqayaa inaanu ahayn wixii aannu u malaynaynay.
examples.note: 'I'm afraid' ma ayu tusi mayso laakiin diidaar adag. Waa luqad culus oo badan.

examples.original: I understand your position, but we would need more flexibility.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr pəˈzɪʃən bʌt wi wʊd nid mɔr ˌflɛksəˈbɪlɪti/
examples.translation: Waxaan ogahay nuqulkaagu, laakiin waxaan u baahanahay midabo badan.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'would need' kala duwan 'need' si aad u eg noqo mid adag iyo aan u adagayn.

examples.original: If you can offer a 10% discount, we would be willing to sign today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju kæn ˈɔfər ə tɛn pɜrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt wi wʊd bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə saɪn təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Haddii aad bixiso khasmaynta 10%, waxaan u adag nahay inaan u qaado xisaabinta maanta.
examples.note: Conditional oo la isticmaalno 'if' + 'would' si loo bixiyo go'an shartiyadeed.

examples.original: Let's meet halfway on the shipping costs.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts mit ˈhæfweɪ ɒn ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ kɔsts/
examples.translation: Waxaan u soo baxay inaan u soo baxanno xiliga dhexdhexaad ee ku saabsan kharashka soo jeeda.
examples.note: 'Meet halfway' waa luqad culus oo lagu soo baxayo xiliga dhexdhexaad ee wadaagga.

examples.original: We have a deal if you agree to these terms.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dil ɪf ju əˈgri tə ðiz tɜrmz/
examples.translation: Waxay noqon doontaa wadaag haddii aad qabto shuruudahaas.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'a deal' kala duwan 'an agreement' si aad u eg noqo mid culus oo wadaagga.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Hadal ka bixinta adag iyo fiilmo
bridge: Ingiriisi, inoo ogolaanaya arraayo ku saabsan buugag iyo fiilmo, waxay isticmaalayaan qoralladaas oo 'I found it...' ama 'It struck me as...', oo aan la ogaain inay noqoto mid ka mid ah farasmalka soomaaliga, oo aan ku isticmaalno 'waxay ii soo jeediyey' ama 'waxay ii noqotay'. Si kastabaaha ha ahaatee, sifaadadii arraayada ingiriiska waxay ku fiicnaan kartaa erayga ugu horreeya (a gripping novel), waxaana soomaaliga ku dhexeeya erayga (nooc adag ah). Kala duwanaanka kale waxay tahay isticmaalka wakhtiga fiilka oo ku saabsan sheeko-sheeko: ingiriishiisa waxay isticmaalayaan muddiga aad u jira oo ku saabsan sheeko-sheeko (the protagonist discovers...), laakiin soomaaliga waxay ku yaal muddiga aad u jira ama muddiga aan la ogaain.
rule: Si aad u hadashid literature iyo cinema ingiriishi ee B2, waa inaad qabashid: 1) Sifaadadii iyo qoralladaas oo 'I found it + sifaad' (I found it thought-provoking) ama 'It struck me as + sifaad' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Sheeko-sheeko muddiga aad u jira (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Isticmaal muddiga dambe ee fiilka oo ku saabsan wakhtiga adag ee aad sheegashid (I read the book last year). 4) Fiirso oo la adeegsanayo 'unlike' ama 'whereas' (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). Waxa aan u adag tahay isticmaalka 'based on' (The movie is based on a novel). Sifaadadii 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' waxay u adag yihiin. Iska ilaa inaad u turjumo 'waxay ii soo jeediyey' 'it seemed to me' kulli; isticmaal 'I thought' ama 'I found'.

concept_examples.text: I found the novel gripping from the first page.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan helay nooc adag ah oo ugu horeeya bogga ugu horreeya.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈnɒvəl ˈɡrɪpɪŋ frəm ðə fɜːst peɪdʒ.

concept_examples.text: The film is based on a true story.
concept_examples.translation: Fiilku wuxuu u adeegsan yahay sheeko dhasan ah.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm ɪz beɪst ɒn ə truː ˈstɔːri.

concept_examples.text: Unlike the book, the movie has a much faster pace.
concept_examples.translation: Kala duwanaanta bogga, fiilku wuxuu u adag yahay xaaladda ugu dhaqsiyahay.
concept_examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ðə bʊk, ðə ˈmuːvi hæz ə mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə peɪs.

concept_examples.text: The author uses symbolism to explore themes of identity.
concept_examples.translation: Macallimihu wuxuu isticmaalayaa siman oo loo eego mawduucyo xoumada.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈɔːθə juːzɪz ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm tuː ɪkˈsplɔː θiːmz ɒv aɪˈdentɪti.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: Ingiriishi, si aad u fiirsan tahay 'than' aan 'that' ahayn. Kuwa af-soomaali ah ayay amar baabba'aan 'that' (oo kala duwan) iyo 'than' (oo kala duwan). Xusuuso: haddii aad fiirsanaysid laba wax, isticmaal 'than' dhammaan.

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: Waxay ii soo jeediyey dhammaan u dhexeeyey.
examples.note: Aannu isticmaalno 'I found + object + sifaad' si aad u soo bixiso arraayo. Waxaa u dhexeeyey 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: Waxay ii soo jeediyey fiilmo aad u adag.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' waxay tahay hadal adag oo ku saabsan fiirsashada shakhsiya.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: Waxay ii soo jeediyey hadalka aad u dhexdhexaad ah.
examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalayaa 'feel' si aad u hadashid fiirsashada shakhsiya.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Sheekuhu wuxuu raacayaa sharafta dhowrsan oo ay soo gaadhi doono shirkii.
examples.note: Isticmaal muddiga aad u jira si aad u sheeko-sheeko sheeko-sheeko, haddii sheeko-sheekuhu yahay muddiga dambe ee fiilka.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: Dhammaan u dhexeeyey, sharaftuhu wuxuu ogyahay runta.
examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalayaa 'in the end' aan 'at the end' ahayn si aad u soo bixiso dhammaan u dhexeeyey sheeko-sheeko.

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Sheeko-sheekuhu wuxuu u badanaa xaalad aan la eegin oo ay soo gaadhi doonto sharafta.
examples.note: Muddiga aad u jira waxaa u dhexeeyey si aad u sheeko-sheeko xaalad aan la eegin.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Halka boggu wuxuu u dhaqsiyahay sheeko-sheeko, fiilku wuxuu u adeegsan yahay sheeko-sheeko oo ku soo jeeda.

examples.translation: Fiilku wuxuu ka saarayaa badan oo ka badan xaalad aan la eegin.

examples.note: Isticmaal 'unlike' ugu horreeya jumla si aad u fiirsan tahay.

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Waxbarasho wararaha caafimaad iyo sayniska
bridge: Faransiis, aan ku tiyaana inaan isticmaalno waqtiga hadda jirka oo ahaaneedha inaan ka hadalno helitaanka sayniska ama wararaha dabada, waxaase ingiriisi ah inay isticmaalaan waqtiga dhammaadaynta si ay u xidhiidaan ugu dambeeyey iyo hadda jirka ('Waxbarashada ayay helayeen...') ama waqtiga dhexdhexaad ah oo ahaaneedha inay ka hadalno xaqiiqooyinka oo khalkooda ('Waxbarashada ayay muujinayeen...'). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ingiriisi ah ayaa ku tiyaana inay isticmaalaan fiicil oo badan oo kala duwan oo 'may', 'might' ama 'could' oo ahaaneedha inay u diriraan imtixaanka iyo xasilloonnimo, waxaase faransiiska ah inay ku tiyaana inay isticmaalaan 'puede' ama qoraallada aan la qaati karo. Kala duwanaanka kale ee muhiimka ah waxay tahay isticmaalka 'however' iyo 'although' oo ahaaneedha inay kala soo baxaan, faransiiska ah waxay u tarjumaya 'sin embargo' iyo 'aunque', laakiin ay leedahay faas iyo qoraalka jira qoraalka.
rule: Si aad u hadashid waxbarashada sayniska iyo dabada ingiriisi ah ee darajada B2, waa inaad qabashid xaaladaha ku xiga: 1) waqtiga dhammaadaynta oo ahaaneedha inaad ka hadashid natiijada dhowrsan iyo xidhiidhka ugu dambeeyey iyo hadda jirka: 'Waxbarashada ayay helayeen dawa cusub' (Ayay helayeen...), vs. waqtiga dhexdhexaad ah oo ahaaneedha inay ka hadalno xaqiiqooyinka oo dhammaaday: 'Waxbarashada ayay noqotay 2020'. 2) Codka aan la qaati karo oo ahaaneedha inay u xidhiidhaan eachalka ama fiicilka, aan la qaati karo eachalka: 'Dawaasha lagaa sameeyo imtixaanka' (Dawaasha lagaa sameeyo imtixaanka). 3) Fiicilada imtixaanka: 'may', 'might', 'could' oo ahaaneedha inay u diriraan qalad: 'Waxyaalahan waxay u oggolaan inay u noqotaan dawaasha cusub' (Waxyaalahan waxay u oggolaan inay u noqotaan dawaasha cusub). 4) Xidhiidhka kala duwanaanta: 'however' (sin embargo), 'although' (aunque), 'despite' (a pesar de), qoraalka u eg (aunque + each + fiicil, ama despite + magaca/-ing). 5) Luqadda akadeemika iyo dabada: 'eachal', 'helitaan', 'calamaanta', 'dawaasha', 'fiican' vs. 'fiican'. Xusuuso in ingiriisi ah ayay u jeedaana inay isticmaalaan magaca natiijada: 'Eachalka oo ay dhaqanka ayay u adeegsaday...'. (Eachalka oo ay dhaqanka ayay u adeegsaday...). Wax ka fahmo adag iyo halqad, oo ku tiyaana waxbarashada.

concept_examples.text: The study shows that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
concept_examples.translation: Waxbarashada ayay muujinaya in ciyaartii adag ay u oggolaan inay ka dhaqaan dhibaatada qalbiga.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstʌdi ʃoʊz ðæt ˈrɛɡjələr ˈɛksərˌsaɪz kæn rɪˈdus ðə rɪsk əv hɑrt dɪˈziz.

concept_examples.text: Scientists have developed a new drug that might slow down the progression of Alzheimer's.
concept_examples.translation: Waxbarashada ayay helayeen dawa cusub oo ay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dhibaatada Alzheimer.
concept_examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv dɪˈvɛləpt ə nu drʌg ðæt maɪt sloʊ daʊn ðə prəˈɡrɛʃən əv ˈæltsˌhaɪmərz.

concept_examples.text: Although the results are promising, many experts remain cautious.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii ay natiijada u fiicnaan, waxyaabaha badanaa ayay ku fiicnaan.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑr ˈprɑmɪsɪŋ ˈmɛni ˈɛkspɜrts rɪˈmeɪn ˈkɔʃəs.

concept_examples.text: The vaccine was tested on thousands of volunteers before being approved.
concept_examples.translation: Dawaasha ayay la sameeyey imtixaanka oo ay ku jirteen boqolkiin oo khalad ah oo ay la sameeyeen.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə vækˈsin wʌz ˈtɛstɪd ɑn ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˌvɑlənˈtɪrz bɪˈfɔr ˈbiɪŋ əˈpruvd.

common_error.wrong: Scientists has discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.correct: Scientists have discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadaha waxay noqotay maxaa yeelay faransiiska ah ma aan kala soo baxino singular iyo boqolka fiicilka 'haber' (hemos/han), laakiin ingiriisi ah 'have' waxay isticmaalataan eachalada boqolka ('waxbarashada') iyo 'has' eachalada singular (he/she/it). Si aad u jeedaano, cadaad eachalka iyo haddii ay boqolka ah ay isticmaala 'have'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xusuuso in 'has' waxay isticmaalataan eachalka saddexaad (he/she/it).

examples.original: A recent study has shown that sleep deprivation affects cognitive function.
examples.phonetic: ə ˈrisənt ˈstʌdi hæz ʃoʊn ðæt slip ˌdɛprɪˈveɪʃən əˈfɛkts ˈkɑɡnɪtɪv ˈfʌŋkʃən.
examples.translation: Waxbarashada dhowrsan ayay muujinayeen in dhibaatada nabadgelyada ayay u oggolaan inay u noqotaan cadaaladda wareeggahanu wata.
examples.note: Isticmaalka waqtiga dhammaadaynta ('has shown') oo ahaaneedha inay xidhiidaan natiijada dhowrsan iyo hadda jirka.

examples.original: Doctors recommend a balanced diet to prevent chronic diseases.
examples.phonetic: ˈdɑktərz ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ə ˈbælənst ˈdaɪət tu prɪˈvɛnt ˈkrɑnɪk dɪˈzizəz.
examples.translation: Dhaqaalaha ayay soo dirayaan inay isticmaalaan cunto la mid ah si ay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dhibaatada adag.
examples.note: Fiicilka soo dirid ('recommend') + magaca; faransiiska ah waxay isticmaalaan 'recomiendan' la qaati karo.

examples.original: The hospital has implemented new protocols to reduce infection rates.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl hæz ˈɪmpləˌmɛntɪd nu ˈproʊtəˌkɔlz tu rɪˈdus ɪnˈfɛkʃən reɪts.
examples.translation: Isbitaalka ayay sameeyeen qaybaha cusub oo ahaaneedha inay u oggolaan inay noqotaan adagga cadaadiska.
examples.note: Waqtiga dhammaadaynta + 'to' + fiicilka oo ahaaneedha inay u eg 'para + fiicil' faransiiska ah.

examples.original: According to the latest research, there is considerable evidence that climate change affects public health.
examples.phonetic: əˈkɔrdɪŋ tu ðə ˈleɪtəst rɪˈsɜrtʃ, ðɛr ɪz kənˈsɪdərəbəl ˈɛvɪdəns ðæt ˈklaɪmət ʧeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ.
examples.translation: Waxyaabaha ugu dambeeyey ayay muujinayeen inay jiraan eachal badan oo ahaaneedha inay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dhibaatada cadaaladda dhibaatooyinka.
examples.note: Tusaale 'according to' (according to) + qoraalka 'there is' oo ahaaneedha inay u eg eachalka.

examples.original: The findings suggest that a new treatment could be effective against the virus.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz səˈdʒɛst ðæt ə nu ˈtritmənt kʊd bi ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈgɛnst ðə ˈvaɪrəs.
examples.translation: Helitaanka ayay soo dirayaan inay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dawa cusub oo ay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dhibaatada fayruuska.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'suggest' + 'that' + qoraalka fiicilka oo ahaaneedha inay u eg 'podría'.

examples.original: However, more research is needed to confirm these results.
examples.phonetic: ˌhaʊˈɛvər, mɔr rɪˈsɜrtʃ ɪz ˈnidɪd tu kənˈfɜrm ðiz rɪˈzʌlts.
examples.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa loo baahan yahay in la sameeyo waxbarashada si loo xidhiidho natiijada.
examples.note: Xidhiidhka 'however' oo u dhexeeyey qoraalka; faransiiska ah 'sin embargo' waxay ku tiyaana inay ku noqotaan qoraalka.

examples.original: Although vaccines are widely available, some populations still lack access to them.
examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ vækˈsinz ɑr ˈwaɪdli əˈveɪləbəl, sʌm ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz stɪl læk ˈæksɛs tu ðɛm.
examples.translation: Haddii ay dhawrsan u heli karo, qaar ka mid ah dadka ayay marayo inay heli karo.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'although' oo ahaaneedha inay u eg qaybta, markaasaa la qaati karo qoraalka.

examples.original: The government must invest more in public health to avoid future pandemics.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt mʌst ɪnˈvɛst mɔr ɪn ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ tu əˈvɔɪd ˈfjuʧər pænˈdɛmɪks.
examples.translation: Dowladda waa inay bixiyaan lacag badan oo ah khalka dabada si ay u oggolaan inay noqotaan dhibaatooyinka ugu dambeeyey.
examples.note: Fiicilka 'must' oo ahaaneedha inay u eg xajiska; faransiiska ah waxay isticmaalaan 'debe' ama 'tiene que'.

examples.original: Despite the economic costs, the lockdown was necessary to save lives.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk kɔsts, ðə ˈlɑkˌdaʊn wʌz ˈnɛsəˌsɛri tu seɪv laɪvz.
examples.translation: Haddii ay lacagaha khalka ah ay noqoto, xadgudubka ayay la qaati karo inay noqotaan nabadgelyada.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'despite + magaca' (aan la qaati karo qoraalka), kala duwan 'although + qoraalka'.

translations.so: Waxbarashada sayniska iyo dabada oo la heli karo

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Waxbarasho dadaalad siyaasadeed iyo bulshada
bridge: Faransiiska, aan ku tiyaanaano subjunctive mood inaanu u sheego arraayo dhibaatooyin siyaasadeed ("Waxaa mid leh inaanu doorbannayno"). Ingiriishi, markii la dhirto adjeective-ka 'important', 'essential' ama 'vital', la isticmaalaa 'subjunctive mood' (qoraalka aasaasiga ee fiilka) 'that' oo aan la qalin lahayn: 'Waxaa mid leh inaanu doorbannayno'. Kala duwan kale oo muhiim ah: Faransiiska, aan isticmaalaa subjunctive present qaybo 'when' ("When there are elections"), laakiin Ingiriishi, la isticmaalaa simple present: 'When there are elections'. Fiirso isticmaalka 'should' oo badan oo hadalkii reer Faransiiska ku tiyaanaa inay ku daraan aan la qalin lahayn qoraalka.
rule: Si aad u dadaaliso siyaasadda iyo bulshada miga B2, waxaa mid leh inaad qabto: 1) 'Subjunctive mood' adjeective-ka u dhexeeyey mid leh ama u baahan yahay (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'Waxaa mid leh inay dowladda u shaqeynaysa haatan'. Qoraalka fiilka wuxuu u eg yahay aasaasiga dadka oo dhan, -s oo aan la qalin lahayn. 2) Qaybooyinka waqtiga 'when', 'if' iyo shartiyada: aan isticmaalin simple present (aan ahayn mustaqbal) qaybta xiga: 'When doorashada noqoto, waxaan ogaan doonnaa natiijada'. 3) Tusaalooyin inay soo bixiyaan isku halaysan/kala duwan: 'Waxaan u maleynayaa', 'Waxaan ka baqayaa', 'Waxaa mid leh, laakiin...'. 4) Isticmaalka 'though' dhimashada qoraalka inay u xasasiin: 'Siasada wanaagsan tahay, laakiin waa qaali ah'. 5) Kala duwanaanta vocabulary: 'politics' waa qoraalka ee umuma; 'policy' waa qoraalka oo kooban. Faransiiska 'politics' waxay ku fidaysaa labada, waxaana u abuuraa khalad.

concept_examples.text: It's crucial that every citizen vote in the upcoming election.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa mid leh in qof kasta oo shaqeeya doorashadii u dambeeyey.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkruːʃəl ðət ˈɛvri ˈsɪtɪzən voʊt ɪn ði ˌʌpˈkʌmɪŋ ɪˈlɛkʃən/

concept_examples.text: When the government takes action, we will see significant changes.
concept_examples.translation: Markii dowladda qaadato qaybaha, waxaan fiicini doonnaa isbeddel ayaa badan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛn ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt teɪks ˈækʃən wi wɪl si sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: Many people argue that the new law is unfair, though it has some advantages.
concept_examples.translation: Dad badan baa u sheegaya qaynuunka cusub oo aan adil ahayn, haddii ay leedahay wax waxaan u fiicnaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə nuː lɔː ɪz ʌnˈfɛr ðoʊ ɪt hæz sʌm ədˈvæntɪdʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: It's essential that the media remain impartial during the campaign.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa mid leh in warbixintii soo jeeda adil u egto kampagga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðət ðə ˈmiːdiə rɪˈmeɪn ɪmˈpɑːrʃəl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kæmˈpeɪn/

common_error.wrong: It's important that the government should do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct: It's important that the government do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct_alt: It's important for the government to do something about unemployment.
common_error.explanation: Faransiiska, badan baa aan ku darnaa 'debería' (should) qoraalka subjunctive: 'Waxaa mid leh inay dowladda u shaqeynaysa waxyaabaha'. Laakiin Ingiriishi, markii la dhirto tusaalooyin mid leh, la isticmaalaa subjunctive (aan 'should' ahayn): fiilka qoraalka aasaasiga ('do'). Haddii aad rabto inaad isticmaashid 'should', waxaad u baahan doontaa qoraalka kale: 'Dowladda waa inay shaqeynaysa waxyaabaha', 'that' oo aan la qalin lahayn. Badanka 'for + infinitive' ayaa saxda ah. Iska ilaar isticmaalka labada qoraalka.

levels.label: Agreeing and Disagreeing Politely
levels.translation: Isku halaysan iyo kala duwan u ah

examples.original: I strongly believe that education should be a priority for every government.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən ʃʊd biː ə praɪˈɔrɪti fɔːr ˈɛvri ˈɡʌvərnmənt/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in waxbarashada waa inay noqoto aasaasiga dowladda kasta.
examples.note: Aan isticmaalin 'strongly believe' inaanu u cadhno arraayo. Faransiiska 'creo firmemente' laakiin fiirso: ha odhan 'I believe strongly' waa qoraalka aan badan isticmaalayn.

examples.original: That's a valid point, but I'm afraid I have to disagree with you there.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ hæv tə ˌdɪsəˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɛr/
examples.translation: Waxaa mid leh, laakiin waxaan ka baqayaa inaan ku kala duwanaynin.
examples.note: Faransiiska, 'me temo que' la isticmaalaa subjunctive: 'me temo que tenga que discrepar'. Ingiriishi isticmaalaa indicative: 'I'm afraid I have to'. Ha isticmaalin 'I am afraid that I must' (qaali ah).

examples.original: I see what you mean, though I think we should look at the bigger picture.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː wʌt juː miːn ðoʊ aɪ θɪŋk wi ʃʊd lʊk æt ðə ˈbɪɡər ˈpɪktʃər/
examples.translation: Waxaan ogahay waxaad doonaysid, haddii aan u eegnayno sawirka weyn.
examples.note: 'Though' dhimashada qoraalka waa mid aan badan isticmaalayn Ingiriishi, waxay u eg yahay 'aunque' Faransiiska laakiin qoraalka wuxuu u jeeda kala duwan.

examples.original: If the government invested more in renewable energy, we could reduce pollution significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪnˈvɛstɪd mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi wi kʊd rɪˈduːs pəˈluːʃən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Haddii dowladda ku shubto lacag badan ee energy-ga cusub, waxaan ka saari doonnaa qalad badan oo aan la qalin lahayn.
examples.note: Faransiiska aan isticmaalin subjunctive (invirtiera) iyo shartiga (podríamos). Ingiriishi aan isticmaalin simple past (invested) iyo 'could' + infinitive. Ha odhan 'If the government would invest' – waa khalad aan badan isticmaalayn.

examples.original: Unless we address the root causes of inequality, social unrest will continue.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlɛs wi əˈdrɛs ðə ruːt ˈkɔːzɪz əv ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti ˈsoʊʃəl ʌnˈrɛst wɪl kənˈtɪnjuː/
examples.translation: Haddii aan u haynin dhibaatooyinka ugu hantiyey adagga, dhibaatooyinka bulshada ayaa sii diyaarsan doontaa.
examples.note: Faransiiska, 'a menos que' waa inay subjunctive u egto: 'abordemos'. Ingiriishi, aan isticmaalin simple present markii la dhirto 'unless' (waxay u eg yahay 'if not'). Ha isticmaalin mustaqbal: 'Unless we will address'.

examples.original: The rise in unemployment is due to the lack of investment in key industries.
examples.phonetic: /ðə raɪz ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɪz duː tə ðə læk əv ɪnˈvɛstmənt ɪn kiː ˈɪndəstriz/
examples.translation: Ku dhowaad shaqaalayaasha oo aan shaqeeynayo waa inay noqoto lacagta aan ku shubay qoraalka ee muhiimka ah.
examples.note: Faransiiska aan isticmaalin 'se debe a'. Ingiriishi, 'is due to' waa qoraalka oo xad gud ah. Ha odhan 'is because of' (haddii ay la socoto, waa qoraalka aan qaali ahayn).

examples.original: A direct consequence of the new policy is that small businesses are struggling to survive.
examples.phonetic: /ə dɪˈrɛkt ˈkɒnsɪkwəns əv ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz ðæt smɔːl ˈbɪznəsɪz ɑːr ˈstrʌɡlɪŋ tə sərˈvaɪv/
examples.translation: Natiijada adag ee siyaasada cusub waxay tahay in shaqaalayaasha yar ayaa isku dayaya inay nastaan.
examples.note: Faransiiska waxaad odhan doontaa 'shaqaalayaasha yar ayaa isku dayaya' – waa mid aan badan u eg yahay. Fiirso: 'policy' waxay u fidaysaa qoraalka oo kooban, aan ahayn qoraalka ee umuma ee siyaasada ('politics').

title: Discussing Budgets and Investments / Ku hadal buuxinta iyo kufadashada
bridge: Ingiriisi, erayadii loo hadlaa lacagta waxay isku beddelan yihiin haddii aad hadashid lacag shaqada ama lacag shakhsi ah. Misaal, 'spend' waxaa loo isticmaalaa lacag silshashada, laakiin 'invest' waxay u cadhoon tahay qaarista aad u badan oo kooban. Af-Soomaaliga, 'invertir' waxaa adag loo isticmaalaa labaduba, laakiin Ingiriisi 'invest' waxaa loo qaybtaa lacag siinashada wax ku fadhiya ama ku filan inaad lacag ka helarto. Kala duwan kale waxaa ah in Ingiriisi waxay isticmaalaan qalab weyn oo erayadii ku jira verbigan: 'invest in', 'spend on', 'pay for'. Af-Soomaaliga, qalab weyn waxay noqon kartaa ama waxay ka isku beddelan yihiin. Fiirso qalab weyn kani si aad u adag tahay.
rule: Si aad u hadashid lacagta Ingiriisi degmada B2, waa inaad qabashid erayada iyo qalab weyn. Erayadii adag loo isticmaalaa: 'earn', 'save', 'spend', 'invest', 'borrow', 'lend', 'owe', 'pay off', 'set aside'. Mid waluba waxay leedahay qalab weyn oo xitaa: 'earn money from', 'save up for', 'spend on', 'invest in', 'borrow from', 'lend to'. Magacyada: 'budget', 'expenses', 'income', 'savings', 'debt', 'interest rate', 'stock market', 'investment portfolio'. Isticmaal xilli each day si aad u hadashid adag ('I save 10% of my income'), iyo xilli perfect si aad u hadashid tijaab ('Have you ever invested in stocks?'). Si aad u abuurto wax ka baxay, isticmaal 'should' ama 'ought to'. Fiirso 'lend' iyo 'borrow': 'lend' waxay tusaaleha tahay siinashada, 'borrow' waxay tusaaleha tahay helashada. Af-Soomaaliga, 'prestar' labaduba waxay u qorsheeyaa, laakiin Ingiriisi waxay erayad u kala duwan yihiin. 'Debt' dhab ahaan waxay noqotay inay u adag tahay, laakiin 'debts' waxaa loo isticmaalaa qaybooyinka kooban. Xusuuso in 'money' waxay noqotay inay u adag tahay, ha addin 'moneys'.

concept_examples.text: I need to set aside some money for unexpected expenses.
concept_examples.translation: Waa inaan qaado qiyaastii lacag ah oo aan ku hayo kharashka aan ku sugan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛt əˈsaɪd sʌm ˈmʌni fɔːr ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ɪkˈspɛnsɪz/

concept_examples.text: She invested in a diversified portfolio to reduce risk.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay ku fadhiisay portfolio oo kala duwan si ay u qaladiso khatarada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈvɛstɪd ɪn ə daɪˈvɜːsɪfaɪd pɔːrtˈfoʊlioʊ tə rɪˈduːs rɪsk/

concept_examples.text: We're saving up for a down payment on a house.

concept_examples.phonetic: /wɪər ˈseɪvɪŋ ʌp fɔːr ə daʊn ˈpeɪmənt ɒn ə haʊs/

concept_examples.text: He borrowed money from the bank to start his business.
concept_examples.translation: Wuxuu ka soo qaaday bankiga lacag si uu bilaabo shaqada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈbɒroʊd ˈmʌni frəm ðə bæŋk tə stɑːrt hɪz ˈbɪznəs/

common_error.wrong: I need to invert in a new computer.
common_error.correct: I need to invest in a new computer.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadku wuu soo baxaa maxaa yeelay af-Soomaaliga 'invertir' waxaa loo isticmaalaa 'lacag silshashada wax ku fadhiya', laakiin Ingiriisi 'invest' waxay u cadhoon tahay lacag siinashada wax ku fadhiya ama ku filan inaad lacag ka helarto. Si aad u bixiso wax ku fadhiya laptop, isticmaal 'spend on' ama 'invest in' haddii aad u eego inay noqoto macmiil. Si aad u qaladiso khalaadka, fiirso haddii aad filan doontid inaad lacag ka helarto; haddii ay noqonayn, isticmaal 'spend'.

levels.label: Talking about spending and saving
levels.translation: Ku hadal kharashada iyo lacagta qaadanida

examples.original: I try to save 20% of my salary every month.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ traɪ tə seɪv twɛnti pɜːrsɛnt əv maɪ ˈsæləri ˈɛvri mʌnθ/
examples.translation: Waxaan ku darayaa 20% oo ah muddiga shahriyadaada lacag qaadanida.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'save' + halqad + 'of' si aad u bixiso qiyaastii lacagta qaadanida.

examples.original: We spent too much on eating out last week.
examples.phonetic: /wiː spɛnt tuː mʌtʃ ɒn ˈiːtɪŋ aʊt læst wiːk/
examples.translation: Waxaan kharashaynaa lacag badan oo aan ku hayo cunto ka baxashada toban ka hor.
examples.note: Xusuuso qalab weyn 'on' oo ku dhexeeya 'spend'.

examples.original: My monthly expenses include rent, utilities, and groceries.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌnθli ɪkˈspɛnsɪz ɪnˈkluːd rɛnt, juːˈtɪlɪtiz, ænd ˈgroʊsəriz/
examples.translation: Kharashadii shahriyada waa inay ku jiraan kirayad, adeegyada iyo cunto.
examples.note: 'Expenses' waxay noqotay inay u adag tahay, ku dhaqdhaqaa 'include'.

examples.original: Investing in stocks can be risky, but it offers high returns.
examples.phonetic: /ɪnˈvɛstɪŋ ɪn stɑːks kæn biː ˈrɪski, bʌt ɪt ˈɔːfərz haɪ rɪˈtɜːrnz/
examples.translation: Kufadashada stock-ka waxay noqon kartaa khatar leh, laakiin waxay bixisaa qiimaynta sare.
examples.note: 'Invest in' + magac. 'Returns' waxay tusaaleha tahay qiimaynta.

examples.original: You should diversify your portfolio to minimize losses.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd daɪˈvɜːrsɪfaɪ jʊər pɔːrtˈfoʊlioʊ tə ˈmɪnɪmaɪz ˈlɔːsɪz/
examples.translation: Waa inaad kala duwan gelisaa portfolio-gaaga si aad u qaladiso khatarada.
examples.note: 'Should' si aad u abuurto wax ka baxay. 'Minimize' 'z' Ingiriisi Mareykan ah.

examples.original: The interest rate on my savings account is quite low.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈɪntrəst reɪt ɒn maɪ ˈseɪvɪŋz əˈkaʊnt ɪz kwaɪt loʊ/
examples.translation: Qiimayntii muddiga shahriyada oo ah lacagta qaadanida waxay u adag tahay.
examples.note: 'Interest rate' waxay noqotay inay u adag tahay. 'Quite' waxay tusaaleha tahay 'u adag'.

levels.label: Managing debt and loans
levels.translation: Wax ka baxashada qarashada iyo lacagta qaadanida

examples.original: I owe the bank a significant amount of money.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ oʊ ðə bæŋk ə sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt əˈmaʊnt ɒv ˈmʌni/
examples.translation: Waxaan qarashaa bankiga qiyaastii lacag ah oo badan.
examples.note: 'Owe' + qof + qiyaastii. Af-Soomaaliga 'deber' waxay ku dhaqaaqaa.

examples.original: She lent me some cash until payday.

examples.translation: Ayay i siisay qiyaastii lacag ah ilaa maalintii lacag la helayo.
examples.note: Dhibic 'lend' waa 'lent'. 'Lend' waxay tusaaleha tahay siinashada, 'borrow' waxay tusaaleha tahay helashada.

examples.original: We are paying off our car loan ahead of schedule.

examples.translation: Waxaan ku bixinnaa lacagta qarashada oo ah macmiilka qalabka aan ku hayo waqtiga aan ku sugan.
examples.note: 'Pay off' waxay noqotay inay u adag tahay lacagta qarashada.

title: Expressing Abstract Ideas and Nuance / Sharaxaad arrimaha iyo xanuunka
bridge: Faransiiska, waxaan ku adag noqonayaa inaan xanuun u sharayno subjunctive iyo jumo 'ilaa ay noqon kartaa' ama 'waxaan u maleynayaa'. Ingiriishi, inaad xanuun u sharaysid arrimahaaga ama aad ku qiyaastid mustaqbalka, waxaa la isticmaalaa fiicilka modal iyo qaybo impersonal oo aan uusan lahayn mid la mid ah. Khaladdu ugu badan waxaa ah in la doonayo in la isticmaalo subjunctive Ingiriishi, oo uma jirin, marka asaacad u ogolaansho ama su'aasha u sharid qaybta fiicilka. Haddana fiirso false friends oo 'actually' (actually) ama 'realize' (to realize).
rule:
Inaad ku hadashid arrimaha iyo xanuunka Ingiriishi B2, waxaa muhiim inaad qabtid:
1. Fiicilka modal ee qiyaastada iyo su'aasha: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'must', 'can't'. Misal: "She might be right" (Waxay noqon kartaa inay haah) - su'aasha waxaa la sharayaa fiicilka modal, aan subjunctive ahayn.
2. Xukunka impersonal oo 'it': "It seems that...", "It is said that...", "It is believed that...". Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa 'se dice', 'se cree', Ingiriishi waxaa la isticmaalaa passive impersonal.
3. Adverbs ee proof: 'apparently', 'presumably', 'totally', 'completely' inay xanuun u sharayaan.
4. Farqiga 'actually' (in reality) iyo 'currently' (currently). 'Realize' waa 'to understand', aan 'realizar' ahayn.
5. Inaad sharaysid arraac: 'I would argue that...', 'I tend to think that...', 'From my perspective...'.
6. Fiirso isticmaalka 'suggest' iyo 'recommend' + that + base form (aan subjunctive lahayn): "I suggest that he go" (aan 'goes' ahayn).
7. Conditional 'would' ee hypothesis: "If I were you, I would..."

concept_examples.text: It might seem counterintuitive, but sometimes failure leads to growth.
concept_examples.translation: Waxay u maleynayaa inay ahayd mid aan u malaynayo, laakiin mararka qaarkood fashilloonu wuxuu u oggolaanayaa in la ku soo baxdo.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt maɪt siːm ˌkaʊntərɪnˈtuːɪtɪv bʌt ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˈfeɪljər liːdz tuː ɡroʊθ

concept_examples.text: I would argue that happiness is not a destination but a way of traveling.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u malaynayaa in farxadda ma aha mid dhammaan, laakiin wixii aad u socoto.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ˈhæpinɪs ɪz nɑːt ə ˌdestɪˈneɪʃən bʌt ə weɪ əv ˈtrævəlɪŋ

concept_examples.text: It is widely believed that our perception of reality is shaped by our experiences.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaa u maleynayaa in aad u badan tahay inaarooyinka nolosha naga soo baxay.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ðæt ˈaʊər pərˈsepʃən əv riˈæləti ɪz ʃeɪpt baɪ ˈaʊər ɪkˈspɪriənsɪz

concept_examples.text: If we were to question every assumption, we would never make progress.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aannu ku qiyaasayno qaybta kasta, ma ay noqon doontaa inaanan horumariyo.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪf wi wər tuː ˈkwestʃən ˈevri əˈsʌmpʃən wi wʊd ˈnevər meɪk ˈprɑːɡres

common_error.wrong: I suggest that he goes to the conference to present his ideas.
common_error.correct: I suggest that he go to the conference to present his ideas.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest he goes to the conference... (less formal)
common_error.explanation: Khaladdu wuxuu ka yimid isticmaalka subjunctive ama present indicative Faransiiska. Ingiriishi, fiicilka 'suggest', 'recommend', 'insist' + that, waxaa la isticmaalaa base form (aan 's' lahayn) qeybta formal. Hadalnaadka kuwo badan waxay isticmaalaan indicative, laakiin qeybta academic ama formal waxaa u fiican in la isticmaalo base form. Inaad ka saartid, xusuuso xukunka: 'suggest that + shakhs + fiicilka base form'.

examples.original: She might not agree with your interpretation of the theory.
examples.phonetic: ʃiː maɪt nɑːt əˈɡriː wɪð jɔːr ɪnˌtɜːrprɪˈteɪʃən əv ðə ˈθɪəri
examples.translation: Waxay noqon kartaa inay aan la kulmayn qiyaastadaada natiijada.
examples.note: Waxaan isticmaalaa 'might not' inay su'aasha u sharayaan. Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa 'puede que no'.

examples.original: That can't be the right conclusion; the data contradict it.
examples.phonetic: ðæt kænt bi ðə raɪt kənˈkluːʒən ðə ˈdeɪtə ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt ɪt
examples.translation: Natiijada ma noqon karo mid qumman; bayaaniyadu waa la qalbiyaa.
examples.note: 'Can't' wuxuu sharayaa inaan su'aasha ahayn. Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: The author must have intended a different meaning.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈɔːθər mʌst hæv ɪnˈtendɪd ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈmiːnɪŋ
examples.translation: Waxaa la yaqaan in qoraaga ayay doonaynin inay u qaybtaan maana kulul.
examples.note: 'Must have + participle' wuxuu sharayaa qiyaastada ee horay. Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa 'debió de' ama 'tiene que haber'.

examples.original: It seems that the argument fails to address the core issue.
examples.phonetic: ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˈɑːrɡjumənt feɪlz tuː əˈdres ðə kɔːr ˈɪʃuː
examples.translation: Waxay u maleynayaa in qaybta aan la qalinaynayo wuxuu u qalbiyaa dhibaatooyinka ugu muhiimsan.
examples.note: 'It seems that' waxaa la isticmaalaa 'parece que' Faransiiska. Fiirso aan 'that' lahayn Ingiriishi aan u adagayn.

examples.original: It is often said that philosophy is the art of asking questions.
examples.phonetic: ɪt ɪz ˈɔːfən sed ðæt fɪˈlɑːsəfi ɪz ði ɑːrt əv ˈæskɪŋ ˈkwestʃənz
examples.translation: Waxaa u maleynayaa in badan ay yidhaahdaan in falsafadu wuxuu u qaybtaa su'aasha.
examples.note: Passive impersonal 'It is said' waxaa la mid ah 'se dice' Faransiiska. Ha isticmaali 'se' sida pronoun reflexive.

examples.original: From my perspective, the ethical dilemma is more complex than it appears.
examples.phonetic: frəm maɪ pərˈspektɪv ði ˈeθɪkəl dɪˈlemə ɪz mɔːr ˈkɑːmpleks ðæn ɪt əˈpɪrz
examples.translation: Xoggayga, dhibaatooyinka arrimaha waxay ku filan tahay in la qiyaaso kulul ugu badan.
examples.note: 'From my perspective' waa sidii aad u sharaysid arraac. 'Dilemma' waa erey Greek, ha la qaran 'dilema' Faransiiska, laakiin hadalka waa la soo jeeda.

examples.original: If humanity were to prioritize collective well-being, many conflicts could be avoided.
examples.phonetic: ɪf hjuːˈmænəti wər tuː praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz kəˈlektɪv wel-ˈbiːɪŋ ˈmeni ˈkɑːnflɪkts kʊd biː əˈvɔɪdɪd
examples.translation: Haddii dadku ay u fiicniin doonaan dhaqanka jamacada, dhibaatooyin badan ayaa la qalbi doonaa.
examples.note: Conditional 'were to' waa formal iyo la isticmaalo hypothesis aan u malaynayo. Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa imperfect subjunctive.

examples.original: Should the theory be proven false, we would need to revise our assumptions.
examples.phonetic: ʃʊd ðə ˈθɪəri biː ˈpruːvən fɔːls wi wʊd niːd tuː rɪˈvaɪz ˈaʊər əˈsʌmpʃənz
examples.translation: Haddii natiijada ay noqon doontaa mid aan qummanayn, waxaa inaan la qiyaaso su'aashayaga.
examples.note: 'Should + shakhs + fiicilka' waa sidii aad u sharaysid 'If...'. Qaybta formal, ee ku salaysan qoraalka academic.

examples.original: Suppose we adopted a utilitarian approach; what would be the consequences?
examples.phonetic: səˈpoʊz wi əˈdɑːptɪd ə ˌjuːtɪlɪˈteriən əˈproʊtʃ wʌt wʊd biː ðə ˈkɑːnsɪkwənsɪz
examples.translation: Isku dhowo inaan isticmaalno qaybta utilitarista; maxaa u soo noqon doona?
examples.note: 'Suppose' oo la soo dhaweeyo simple past wuxuu sharayaa hypothesis. Faransiiska waxaan isticmaalaa 'supongamos que' + subjunctive.

title: Discussing Art and Culture / Waxbarashada Sannada iyo Diinta
bridge: Faransiis, aan ku adeegnaynaa mudaaradha aasaasiga ah inaan u sheegno sharciga xilldhiwaanka iyo mudaaradha kordhinimo ah inaan u sheegno tijaabada dhowrsan leh (Ma aragtay...?). Ingiriisi, 'mudaarad kordhinimo ah' (ku aragtay) ayaa badan uga adeegsan yahay tijaabada nolosha iyo wararkii dhowrsan leh, waxaana 'mudaarad dhowrsan leh' uga adeegsan yahay waqtiga xilli-dhiwaanka ee dhow. Qalab kale muhim: Ingiriisi, cadaadad arrimaha (waa adag, waa qurux), ay ku noqotaan ilaa arrimaha sheyga, sida ay tahay Faransiiska, laakiin fiirso arrinka cadaadada: Ingiriisi waxaad dhahdaa 'a beautiful old painting' 'an old beautiful painting'. Sidaa darteed, Ingiriisi waxaan u adeegnaynaa 'the' inaan u sheegno wax ku saabsan wax ku hadlaya ama la garanayo, Faransiiska waxaan u adeegnaynaa.
rule:
Inaad waxbarashada sannada iyo diinta Ingiriisi ku hadashid B2, waa inaad u qabto:
- Isticmaal mudaarad aasaasiga inaad u sheegto sharciga xilldhiwaanka: 'The painting depicts...'
- Isticmaal mudaarad kordhinimo ah inaad u sheegto tijaabada: 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Isticmaal mudaarad dhowrsan leh inaad u sheegto tijaabada dhowrsan leh: 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Cadaadad: arrinka sax (fiir, suuragal, da'da, material, asalka) iyo isticmaal 'so' iyo 'such' inaad u cadhaysid.
- Sheekada arrimaha: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Qaybo modaalka inaad u sheegto: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

concept_examples.text: The painting depicts a woman holding a flower.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u sheegnay in sharciga xilldhiwaanka wuxuu u sheegay naag ay lahaane dhalic.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋ dɪˈpɪkts ə ˈwʊmən ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈflaʊər

concept_examples.text: I have never seen such a breathtaking sculpture.
concept_examples.translation: Anigu marna ma aragtay sharciga xilldhiwaanka oo adag oo aan ku fiicanayn.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ hæv ˈnɛvər sɛn sʌtʃ ə ˈbrɛθteɪkɪŋ ˈskʌlptʃər

concept_examples.text: The artist might have been inspired by nature.
concept_examples.translation: Sharciga xilldhiwaanka wuxuu u sheegay inuu ka soo baxay tabiar.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈɑrtɪst maɪt hæv bɪn ɪnˈspaɪərd baɪ ˈneɪtʃər

concept_examples.text: It's a stunning mix of colors and textures.
concept_examples.translation: Waa mijaaj oo la yaabi'ayay midab iyo shey.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɪts ə ˈstʌnɪŋ mɪks əv ˈkʌlərz ənd ˈtɛkstʃərz

common_error.wrong: I have seen that painting yesterday.
common_error.correct_alt: I have seen that painting before.
common_error.explanation: Khalaaddu waa inaad isticmaashid 'mudaarad kordhinimo ah' la sheekada waqtiga dhowrsan leh sida 'malintii dabeecad'. Ingiriisi, markaad soo bandhigto waqtiga dhowrsan leh, waa inaad isticmaashid 'mudaarad dhowrsan leh'. 'Mudaarad kordhinimo ah' ayaa uga adeegsan yahay tijaabada aanan waqtiga u xusinayn ama waqtiga aan dhamayn. Inaad ka saartid, xusuuso: haddaad dhahdid 'malintii dabeecad', 'sannad dambe', '1990', isticmaal 'mudaarad dhowrsan leh'. Haddii aad isticmaashid 'mar walba', 'marna', 'ka dambayntii', isticmaal 'mudaarad kordhinimo ah'.

examples.original: The sculpture represents a human figure in motion.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈskʌlptʃər ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnts ə ˈhjumən ˈfɪgjər ɪn ˈmoʊʃən
examples.translation: Sharciga xilldhiwaanka wuxuu u sheegay shakhsiye aad u jiray inuu u socoto.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'represents' inaad u sheegto mowjiiska sharciga xilldhiwaanka. Faransiiska, waxaan u adeegnaynaa 'representa', laakiin 'es' ama 'trata de' una isticmaalin.

examples.original: The use of light and shadow creates a dramatic effect.
examples.phonetic: ðə jus əv laɪt ənd ˈʃædoʊ kriˈeɪts ə drəˈmætɪk ɪˈfɛkt
examples.translation: Isticmaalka iftiinka iyo gudcurka waxay u abuurtaa cadaabad dhib.
examples.note: Fiirso arrinka: 'the use of light' (isticmaalka iftiinka) waxay Ingiriisi ugu dhowrsan tahay 'the light's use'.

examples.original: I find the colors in this painting very soothing.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faɪnd ðə ˈkʌlərz ɪn ðɪs ˈpeɪntɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈsuðɪŋ
examples.translation: Waxaan helay in midabka sharciga xilldhiwaanka ayaa u adag.
examples.note: Qalabka 'I find + object + adjective' waxay Ingiriisi ugu dhexeeya tahay arrimaha. Faransiiska, waxaan dhahnaynaa 'me parece'.

examples.original: In my view, the artist's early work is more authentic.
examples.phonetic: ɪn maɪ vju, ðə ˈɑrtɪsts ˈɜrli wɜrk ɪz mɔr ɔˈθɛntɪk
examples.translation: Fiirsideyga, sharciga xilldhiwaanka hore ee sharciga xilldhiwaanka waa u adag.
examples.note: 'In my view' waxay ka badan tahay 'I think'. Hadalka, waxaa badan uga adeegsan yahay 'I feel'.

examples.original: That exhibition blew my mind.
examples.phonetic: ðæt ˌɛksɪˈbɪʃən blu maɪ maɪnd
examples.translation: Tijaabadu wuxuu i dhibay inaan u malayo.
examples.note: Sheekada 'blow my mind' waxay u adag tahay laakiin badan uga adeegsan yahay. Faransiiska, 'me voló la cabeza'.

examples.original: The film was so moving that I couldn't hold back tears.
examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm wʌz soʊ ˈmuvɪŋ ðæt aɪ ˈkʊdənt hoʊld bæk tɪrz
examples.translation: Fiilmku wuxuu aad u adag ayuu i dhibay inaan u qaado dhibaatada.
examples.note: Qalabka 'so + adjective + that' inaad u sheegto sabab. Faransiiska, 'tan + adjective + que'.

examples.original: What strikes me most is the attention to detail.
examples.phonetic: wʌt straɪks mi moʊst ɪz ðə əˈtɛnʃən tu dɪˈteɪl
examples.translation: Waxaan ku fiicanaynay in waxa ugu adag ay tahay xusuusta.
examples.note: 'What strikes me' waxay u adag tahay inaad dhahdid 'me impresiona'. Faransiiska, 'lo que más me llama la atención'.

examples.original: This festival dates back to the 16th century.

examples.translation: Tijaabadu wuxuu ka soo baxay saddadeenad.
examples.note: 'Dates back to' waxay sheekada u adag tahay inaad dhahdid 'se remonta'. Faransiiska, waxaan u adeegnaynaa 'se remonta a'.

examples.original: The museum has launched a new exhibition on modern art.
examples.phonetic: ðə mjuˈziəm hæz lɔnʧt ə nu ˌɛksɪˈbɪʃən ɑn ˈmɑdərn ɑrt
examples.translation: Madxafka waxay bixiseen tijaabad cusub oo ku saabsan sharciga xilldhiwaanka oo dhexdhexaad ah.
examples.note: 'Mudaarad kordhinimo ah' ayaa halkan uga adeegsan yahay shuqulka dhowrsan leh oo leh xusid oo dhan. Faransiiska, 'ha lanzado' waxay u adeegsan yahay sidaa.

examples.original: If I had more time, I would visit every gallery.
examples.phonetic: ɪf aɪ hæd mɔr taɪm, aɪ wʊd ˈvɪzɪt ˈɛvri ˈgæləri
examples.translation: Haddii aan lahaa waqtiga, waxaan u tagaa galariyada oo dhan.
examples.note: Labada sharciga inaad u sheegto tijaabada la xiriira. Faransiiska, 'si hayo... visitaría'.

examples.original: It's essential that we preserve our cultural heritage.
examples.phonetic: ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðæt wi prɪˈzɜrv aʊr ˈkʌlʧərəl ˈhɛrɪtɪʤ
examples.translation: Waa inaan dhawrno mirisnaanta diinta.
examples.note: Isticmaalka modaalka Ingiriisi: 'It's essential that + subject + verb base'. Faransiiska, 'esencial que + subjuntivo'.

title: Problem-solving discussions / Nala soo xiriira xogta
bridge: Faransiis, inooji macaaladda waxay ku isticmaalaan subjunctive ama jumo 'we could' iyo 'what if...?'. Ingiriisi, ka badan, waxay ku isticmaalaan qiyaastii modal iyo conditional. Khalad weyn waxay tahay 'if I would' si adag loo tarjumiyo 'if I were' (conditional labaad). Ingiriisi, 'should' iyo 'ought to' waxay u fiican yihiin inay soo bixiyaan xubuun, halmarintii 'deberías' Faransiiska waa adag oo ka badan.
rule:
Ingiriisi, si aad u xogta iyo inaad soo bixiso macaalad, waxaad isticmaali kartaa sawirro badan:
1. **Conditional labaad** (khaali ah): 'If + simple past, would + base verb'. Misal: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' Waxay u adeegsan yahay qiyaastii aan la fiirsanayn.
2. **Conditional saddexaad** (khaali ugu horreysay): 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle'. Misal: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' Waxay u adeegsan yahay qiyaastii aan la helin.
3. **Modalities oo loo soo bixiyo**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + base verb. 'Had better' waa adag oo ka badan oo aan u xanuuniyo natiijo xumahood.
4. **Jumo oo loo soo bixiyo**: 'What about...?', 'How about...?', 'Why don't we...?', 'Could we...?', 'Maybe we should...'.
5. **Jumo oo loo eegayo khaladood**: 'On the one hand... on the other hand...', 'The advantage is...', 'The downside is...', 'It might work because...'.
6. **Agreement iyo isku xanaaq**: 'I see your point, but...', 'That sounds reasonable, however...', 'I'm not convinced that...'.
Ha isticmaal 'would' qiyaastii 'if' (khaalka weyn ee ku dhacaya dadka Faransiiska).

concept_examples.text: If I were you, I would talk to the manager.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan ahayd adiga, waxaan la hadlayee mudarkii.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː, aɪ wʊd tɔːk tə ðə ˈmænɪdʒər/

concept_examples.text: We could try a different approach.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaynu u macquulnaa inooji doorasho kala duwan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd traɪ ə ˈdɪfrənt əˈproʊtʃ/

concept_examples.text: Why don't we brainstorm some solutions?
concept_examples.translation: Maxaa yeelay inaan sameeyno brainstorming?
concept_examples.phonetic: /waɪ doʊnt wiː ˈbreɪnstɔːrm sʌm səˈluːʃənz/

concept_examples.text: The advantage is that it saves time, but the downside is the cost.
concept_examples.translation: Faa’iidata waa inay badbaadiso wakhti, laakiin kharashka waa kharashka qiimaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt ɪt seɪvz taɪm, bʌt ðə ˈdaʊnsaɪd ɪz ðə kɔːst/

common_error.wrong: If I would have more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct: If I had more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had more money, I could buy a new car.
common_error.explanation: Khaalka wuxuu u dhacayaa maxaa yeelay Faransiiska waxay nuuqato 'si aan u noqon lahaa' (ama 'si aan u haysta lahaa'), laakiin Ingiriisi, qiyaastii labaad, qiyaastii 'if' waxay isticmaalaan simple past (aan 'would' ahayn). 'Would' waxay ku noqon kartaa qiyaastii ugu muhiimsan. Ka tiraa tarjumaadka adag. Xusuuso: 'If + simple past, would + verb'.

examples.original: How about we set a deadline?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt wiː sɛt ə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
examples.translation: Maxaa yeelay inaan soo bandhigmo mudhar la'aan?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'How about' + subject + verb in present si aad u soo bixiso su’aalo. Waxay ka sii qallafsan tahay 'What about'.

examples.original: Maybe we should invest in better software.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst ɪn ˈbɛtər ˈsɒftwɛər/
examples.translation: Waana inaan gudbiyeyno inaan gudbiyeyno software wanaagsan.
examples.note: 'Should' waxay u fiican yihiin inay soo bixiyaan xubuun. B2, waxaad isticmaali kartaa 'I think we should' si aad u qallafiso.

examples.original: Could we ask for an extension?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wiː ɑːsk fɔːr ən ɪkˈstɛnʃən/
examples.translation: Maxaa yeelay inaan weydiiyey mudhar la'aan?
examples.note: 'Could' waa ugu adag oo ka badan 'can' si aad u soo bixiso su’aalo.

examples.original: On one hand, it's cheaper, but on the other hand, it's less reliable.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn wʌn hænd, ɪts ˈtʃiːpər, bʌt ɒn ði ˈʌðər hænd, ɪts lɛs rɪˈlaɪəbl/
examples.translation: Qeyb ka mid ah, waxay ka sii jaban tahay, laakiin qeyb kale, waxay ka sii qallafsan tahay.
examples.note: Sawirro ugu muhiimsan ee soo bixinta faa’iido iyo kharashka xogta.

examples.original: The main drawback is that it requires training.
examples.phonetic: /ðə meɪn ˈdrɔːbæk ɪz ðæt ɪt rɪˈkwaɪərz ˈtreɪnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Kharashka ugu muhiimsan waa inay u baahan yihiin tacliin.
examples.note: 'Drawback' waxay u dhadhamiyaan 'kharashka'. Isticmaalaa qiyaastii shaqo.

examples.original: I'm not convinced that this will solve the issue.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt kənˈvɪnst ðæt ðɪs wɪl sɒlv ði ˈɪʃuː/
examples.translation: Anigu ma quudheen in waxaanu u qalinayo xogta.
examples.note: SoO bixi isku xanaaq 'I'm not convinced' + 'that'.

examples.original: If we all agree, we can move forward.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ɔːl əˈɡriː, wiː kæn muːv ˈfɔːrwərd/
examples.translation: Haddii naga ii soo jeedo, waxaynu u socon karnaa.
examples.note: Conditional ugu horeeya ee natiijo haqiiqi ah. B2, ku xira qiyaastii conditional iyo verbs modal.

examples.original: Would you be open to a compromise?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː ˈoʊpən tə ə ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/
examples.translation: Ma adag tahay inaad u soo bixiso xanuun?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'would' su’aalo qallafsan si aad u xanuuniso.

examples.original: I think we need to find a middle ground.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wiː niːd tə faɪnd ə ˈmɪdl ɡraʊnd/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u baahnay inaan helno meel dhexdhexaad.
examples.note: Jumo ku saabsan 'middle ground' = meel dhexdhexaad.

examples.original: So we're all on the same page?
examples.phonetic: /soʊ wɪər ɔːl ɒn ðə seɪm peɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Haddii aad isku dayo, waxaynu u socon karnaa?
examples.note: 'On the same page' waxay u dhadhamiyaan inay isku dayaan ama inay leh faham badan.

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Hadal sanad iyo baahsan
bridge: Faransiis waxay ku tusedhaa inaan isticmaalno hal-munaaraddii xaaladda ama isticmaalno dushooda (in + infinitive) si aan u hadalno sanad, laakiin Ingiriisi waxaa u dhowrsan inaan isticmaalno xirfadooyin la mid ah 'I’m planning to', 'I intend to' ama isticmaalno dushooda 'will' si aan u soo jeedin qoraallooyin adag. Waxaa lagu qalin laayaa inaan isticmaalno 'would like' (waxaan jeclaanahay) ee muujinaya qoraallooyin rasmi ah ama kala duwan, waxaana u dhaqanqaati furan 'quiero' oo ah qoraal aad u xanuun ah. Kala duwan kale oo muhiim ah: Ingiriisi waxay ku tusedhaa inaan isticmaalno gerund (-ing) ka dib markii ay noqon prepositions iyo erayadooyin kala duwan oo la mid ah 'look forward to', halmarina Faransiis waxay ku tusedhaa inaan isticmaalno infinitives.
rule: Si aad hadashid u hadashid sanad iyo baahsan Ingiriisi B2, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa xirfadooyin kala duwan: 1) 'be going to + infinitive' si ay u soo jeedin qoraallooyin iyo baahsan oo xoolo la'aan (I’m going to start a business). 2) 'will + infinitive' si ay u soo jeedin qoraallooyin adag ama kala duwan (I’ll do my best). 3) 'would like + infinitive' ama 'would love + infinitive' si ay u soo jeedin qoraallooyin (I’d like to improve my English). 4) Erayadooyin la mid ah 'hope', 'plan', 'intend', 'expect' oo la soo jeeda infinitive (I hope to travel, I plan to save money). 5) Xirfadooyin gerund oo ka soo jeeda prepositions: 'look forward to + -ing', 'be interested in + -ing'. 6) Shartiga ugu horeeya sanad oo la sharti: 'If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam'. Khalaadadooyin ku tihid: siinaya 'to' oo ka soo jeeda infinitives, isticmaalaya infinitive ka dib markii ay noqon prepositions (sax: 'I’m good at learning'), iyo kala xumaya 'will' iyo hal-munaaraddii si ay u hadashid qoraallooyin oo xoolo la'aan. Hadana xusuuso in 'hope' waxay u dhaqanqaati furan hal-munaaraddii ee hore (I hope I get the job).

concept_examples.text: I’m planning to start my own business next year.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan qorsheeyaa inaan bilowga agarada aan u qayb galayo sanadka ee dhammaad.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈplænɪŋ tə stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈbɪznəs nekst jɪr/

concept_examples.text: I’d like to improve my public speaking skills.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaanahay inaan siinayo qaybtaada si aan u fiicino qaybtaada ee hadalka dadka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈpʌblɪk ˈspiːkɪŋ skɪlz/

concept_examples.text: If I work hard, I’ll achieve my goals.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aan shaqeyn diyaarsan, waxaan heli doonaa sanadkayga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːrk hɑːrd aɪl əˈtʃiːv maɪ ɡoʊlz/

concept_examples.text: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ku sugayaa inaan guulaysto jirrabka jirrabka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪŋ frəm ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti/

common_error.wrong: I look forward to graduate from university.
common_error.correct: I look forward to graduating from university.
common_error.correct_alt: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
common_error.explanation: Khalaadadu wuxuu muujayaa maxaa yeelay Faransiis waxaa lagu yidhaahda 'deseando + infinitive' (waxaan ku sugayaa inaan guulaysto jirrabka). Ingiriisi, ka dib markii ay noqon 'look forward to', preposition 'to' waxay u qaybtaa gerund (-ing), ma aha infinitive. Tani waa khalad oo ku tihid kuwa hadalka Faransiis. Xusuuso: mar kastoo 'to' noqonayo preposition (ma aha qayb oo ka mid ah infinitive), waxay ku soo jeeda -ing.

examples.original: I’m going to start a new hobby this summer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə nuː ˈhɑːbi ðɪs ˈsʌmər/
examples.translation: Waxaan qorsheeyaa inaan bilowga agarada ee cusub sanadka ee dhammaad.
examples.note: 'Be going to' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa qoraallooyin oo xoolo la'aan oo ka hor jeeda wakhti oo lagu hadashid.

examples.original: I intend to apply for that job in London.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɪnˈtend tə əˈplaɪ fɔːr ðæt dʒɑːb ɪn ˈlʌndən/
examples.translation: Waxaan qorsheeyaa inaan soo magacaabo shaxantii London.
examples.note: Erayga 'intend' waxay ku soo jeeda 'to + infinitive'. Waxaa u dhexeeya 'going to'.

examples.original: I’m hoping to save enough money for a trip.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə seɪv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni fɔːr ə trɪp/
examples.translation: Waxaan rajeynayaa inaan soo ururiyo lacag la'aan si aan u tixraaco safar.
examples.note: Erayga 'hope' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa hal-munaaraddii ee dhadhamiya si ay u soo jeedin qoraal adag.

examples.original: I plan to learn Spanish next year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ plæn tə lɜːrn ˈspænɪʃ nekst jɪr/
examples.translation: Waxaan qorsheeyaa inaan bartaan Faransiis sanadka ee dhammaad.
examples.note: 'Plan to' waxay ku soo jeeda infinitive iyo waxaa lagu isticmaalaa qoraallooyin oo xoolo la'aan.

examples.original: If I get a promotion, I’ll buy a house.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ɡet ə prəˈmoʊʃən aɪl baɪ ə haʊs/
examples.translation: Haddii aan la soo baxdo, waxaan iibi doonaa guri.
examples.note: Shartiga ugu horeeya Ingiriisi: if + hal-munaaraddii, will + infinitive. Ma nistiismaalino dushooda ee ku saabsan 'if'.

examples.original: Unless I start saving now, I won’t be able to travel.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles aɪ stɑːrt ˈseɪvɪŋ naʊ aɪ woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈtrævəl/
examples.translation: Haddii aan bilowga agarada aan u qayb galayo, ma aan u tixraaco safar.
examples.note: 'Unless' waxay u dhaqanqaati furan 'haddii aan' iyo waxay ku jirtaa kala duwan, sidaa darteed ma nistiismaalino 'not' qaybtaas.

examples.original: Provided that I finish my thesis, I’ll graduate in June.
examples.phonetic: /prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈθiːsɪs aɪl ˈɡrædʒueɪt ɪn dʒuːn/
examples.translation: Haddii aan dhammaanayo taasoo ah, waxaan guulaysaa jirrabka jirrabka.
examples.note: 'Provided that' waxaa u dhexeeya 'if' iyo waxay u dhaqanqaati furan 'haddii'.

examples.original: Once I have enough experience, I’ll start my own company.
examples.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ hæv ɪˈnʌf ɪkˈspɪriəns aɪl stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈkʌmpəni/
examples.translation: Markii aan helin tijaab la'aan, waxaan bilowga agarada aan u qayb galayo shirkadii aan u qayb galayo.
examples.note: Waxay isticmaalna 'once' + hal-munaaraddii si ay u soo jeedin dushooda, waxay u dhaqanqaati furan 'markii'.

examples.original: I would love to become a successful writer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv tə bɪˈkʌm ə səkˈsesfəl ˈraɪtər/
examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaanahay inaan noqdo qoraa oo liibaan.
examples.note: 'Would love to' waxaa u dhexeeya 'would like to' iyo waxaa lagu isticmaalaa qoraallooyin adag.

examples.original: My dream is to travel around the world and help communities.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə ˈtrævəl əˈraʊnd ðə wɜːrld ənd help kəˈmjuːnətiz/
examples.translation: Dhibtaydii waa inaan safar u tixraaco dunida iyo inaan caawiyo jamacadaha.
examples.note: Markii ay dhibta noqonayo calaamad, waxay isticmaalna 'is to + infinitive' si ay u soo jeedin sanadka.

examples.original: I’m working towards becoming a certified coach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˈwɔːrdz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrtɪfaɪd koʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Waxaan shaqeeyaa si aan u noqdo macallimad oo saxan.
examples.note: Xirfhada 'work towards' waxay ku soo jeeda gerund maxaa yeelay 'towards' waa preposition.

examples.original: In ten years’ time, I hope to have my own practice.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ten jɪrz taɪm aɪ hoʊp tə hæv maɪ oʊn ˈpræktɪs/
examples.translation: Todobaad, waxaan rajeynayaa inaan helin shirkadii aan u qayb galayo.
examples.note: Waxay isticmaalna 'in + wakhti + wakhti' si ay u soo jeedin wakhti ee dushooda.
